Description: Sambungmacan (also spelled Sambingan) is an open site on the south bank of the Solo River in central Java. Several Homo erectus crania have been found here, including Sambungmacan 1, 3, and 4. The fossils date to the late Middle Pleistocene and are important for understanding the evolution of Homo erectus in Java.

Description: Patiayam is an important fossil site in Kudus Regency, Central Java, part of the Patiayam Dome on the Muria Mountain slope. The site has yielded numerous Pleistocene fossils including Stegodon, giant tortoise, and other megafauna. Associated with the Northern zone of Java Homo erectus sites.

Description: The excavation findings are very interesting, including artifacts of both bones and shells. Some findings show a variety of tool types with lithic technology. In addition, based on the sedimentation process, it seems that Kidang Cave AA is drier than the deposits that occur in Kidang Cave A. This provides an interpretation, that between Kidang Cave A and Kidang Cave AA there was a different arrangement or pattern of activity and habitation.

COMMENTS: Description: On the eastern part of this hill there is a large monolith (whole stone) standing upright. From the existence of this standing stone, the hill was named Seladiri which means standing stone. The location of the site on a hill reminds us of the worldview of the supporters of the megalithic tradition who believed that mountains were important places for spirits. Local folklore mentions that Seladiri hill is the burial place of Mbah Dresmo who is believed to be the origin of Terjan Village.
